title: John Calvin
source: Public domain. Consolidated from John Calvin, Commentary upon the Acts of the Apostles, translated by Christopher Fetherstone, Calvin Translation Society, and the Institutes of the Christian Religion, translated by Henry Beveridge; both as published by the Christian Classics Ethereal Library.
body: John Calvin on Acts, chapter 16. In his Commentary upon the Acts of the Apostles, in the Christopher Fetherstone translation, Calvin writes at Acts 16, verse 1: Luke doth now begin to declare what were the proceedings of Paul after that Barnabas and he were separate. In the Institutes of the Christian Religion, in the Henry Beveridge translation, Calvin draws on this chapter again in Book 3, chapter 19.
